reason: Bind immutable execution traces to the verified per-result content before derived publication.
changes: A canonical result hash covers case, harness, variant, mode, repetition, validity, acceptance, and assertion counts.
Generic, Neo, and skill-development adapters write that hash into each task trace root with evaluation identity.
The publisher queries each trace and validates its single root, identity, and result hash before any assessment, dataset, or summary mutation.
Specialized failure records now preserve the complete normalized result core and retryable evidence.

tdd.red: no per-result trace hash or publisher trace-content validation existed
green: changing a verified outcome changes the trace result hash
publisher rejects a trace bound to different result content
all generic and specialized suites retain normalized result fields
